unit.why: A brief anecdote: R. Moshe, author of Divrei Torah, enters the Kozhenitser Maggid's house before dawn and overhears him weeping in prayer for his young hasidim, followed by an authorial remark that more could be told.
unit.boundary_note: closes a digression; the next division returns to the main narrative ('ונחזור להנ"ל')

stories.start_quote: פ״א קודם אור הבוקר נכנס הרב החסיד
stories.summary_en: Before dawn R. Moshe, author of Divrei Torah, entered the house of his master the Kozhenitser Maggid and heard him weeping and praying that his young hasidim be guarded and saved from sin.
